items.name: issue-writer
items.title: Issue Writer
items.description: Turn a rough bug report, idea, or complaint into an actionable issue by investigating the codebase first for reproduction steps, expected vs actual behaviour, suspected location, and acceptance criteria, then filing it with gh or emitting paste-ready markdown. Use when asked to file or write up an issue, or when a bug mentioned in passing should be tracked.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
